source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
**LEAGUES OF VOTANN** units in your army have **Guerrilla Adepts**: in your [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase), right after the unit is picked to shoot, it may pick 1 enemy unit other than **MONSTERS** and **VEHICLES**. Then:

- For the rest of the phase, the unit's models may target only that enemy unit, provided the target is eligible.
- If any of those attacks hit, the enemy unit is assailed until your next [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase) starts.
- If the enemy unit was already assailed, it is also pinned until then.

A pinned unit gets -2" Move and -2 to its Charge rolls. Assailed is only a label, used by this ability and by certain Stratagems and Enhancements.
